profile.headline: Info Sec Engineer at USAA | Security+ | AF Veteran
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer, and prior active duty Air Force with a background in Information Technology as a cyber system operator (systems administration) and customer support/troubleshooting.  CompTia Security+ certified with a TS/SCI clearance.  I am motivated to learn and excited to pursue a different technical path as a developer.

positions.title: Mission Assurance Flight Commander - Information Technology Specialist
positions.locationName: Lackland Air Force Base, Texas, United States
positions.description:
- Led a team of 4 members to provide IT customer support and mission assurance for approximately 60 military and civilian personnel
- Served as a point of contact for creating and managing user network accounts for Unclassified and Classified systems, increasing efficient support for network access, and performed hardware troubleshooting
- Managed tickets submitted by users and maintained inventory of all IT equipment

positions.title: Chief of Staff Executive Assistant
positions.description:
- Maintained calendars, meeting requests, reviewed memorandums and answered telephone calls for the Air Force Global Strike Command Chief of Staff and Deputy Chief of Staff
- Managed a monthly video conference for the Air Force Global Strike Commander and the 11 subordinate Air Force bases across the United States
- Performed personnel timekeeping duties and served as a Defense Travel System approving official for approximately 40 personnel

positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.description:
- Studied organizational processes and revamped the secretarial processes, improved administrative efficiency
- Organized programs and managed the fitness program, provided a monthly analysis for all personnel and maintained a tracking Excel spreadsheet for compliance
- Utilized the Microsoft Office suite on a daily basis

positions.title: EIM Tier II System Administrator
positions.description:
- Managed a 3 member maintenance team that patched servers/mitigated network vulnerabilities
- Acquired security certifications after identifying an issue, ensuring the on-time completion of a high priority project
- Deployed virtual servers and removed physical deployment servers as a lead tech for SharePoint upgrade

positions.title: Major Command Server Operations System Administrator
positions.description:
- Deployed and maintained web applications with databases that serviced users across the Department of Defense
- Executed daily database backups while conducting preventative server maintenance actions

honors.title: Civilian Cat II of the Quarter
Civilian Cat II of the Quarter
